northStar: A voice-only assistant anyone with a Cloudflare account can use, where every word is heard, thought, and spoken on their own Workers AI through their own AI Gateway.
falsifiable: A person signs in with Cloudflare at hark.coey.dev, taps once, asks a question out loud, hears an answer, interrupts it, and never sees or types text.
proven: 42 offline tests: sign-in round trip, gateway refusal, upstream routing, turn order, streaming, eager gate, barge-in abort, filler and recovery speech, speech prep, client stories
17/17 e2e in headless Chromium against a fake Cloudflare: weather card, memory, painting, barge-in, DO alarm timer, camera look, goodbye, one-tap re-wake, layout on desktop and phone
hark.coey.dev live: OAuth client public and verified, edge check passes, real sign-in, 5 spoken turns through the user gateway with their OAuth token (receipts/live-signin.json)
Live Workers AI bench: Flux + GPT-OSS 20B + Aura 1 at 1,642 ms p50 speech end to first audio byte (receipts/bench-live-direct.json)
unproven: Echo cancellation on real hardware with a real human voice
